sources: Google Maps place 'Calaway Park Campground' (via gm.py, 2026-11-10)

values.note: 2026 nightly rates plus GST: power only C$48; full service back-in 15/30-amp C$52, pull-through 30-amp C$57, back-in 50-amp C$62; tenting/non-serviced C$43 (sites 1-7). C$5 more during the Calgary Stampede (Jul 2-12, 2026). Second tent C$7. The 7th night of a week's stay is free. Two-night and one-night packages with park tickets also sold.

fees.source: https://www.calawaypark.com/stay-and-play/campground/ (read 2026-11-10): 'Full Service (power, water, sewer) – Back In (50amp) $62.00+GST $67.00+GST', 'Pull Through (30amp) $57.00+GST $62.00+GST', 'Back-In (15 and 30amp) $52.00+GST $57.00+GST', 'Power Only $48.00+GST $53.00+GST', 'Tenting/Non-Serviced $43.00+GST $48.00+GST', 'Stampede Nightly Rate (July 2 to 12)', 'Additional people (more than 6) $2.00/person/night', '(If staying a week, the 7th night is free!)'

values.note: 2026: weekends only (Fri/Sat/Sun nights) May 15 - June 4, then daily June 5 - September 7.

season.source: https://www.calawaypark.com/stay-and-play/campground/: '2026 Operating Dates: Weekends Only (Fri/Sat/Sun nights): May 15 to June 4, 2026 Daily: June 5 to September 7, 2026'

values.note: Online through the park's own (accesso) booking system or by phone 403-249-7372. Sites are assigned at check-in. Maximum 14 nights per camping season. Check-in 1 pm, check-out 11 am (noon / 10 am during Stampede); gates closed 10 pm - 6 am. Cancel 3+ days ahead free; later, a C$5 fee; day-of and no-shows pay one night.

booking.source: https://www.calawaypark.com/stay-and-play/campground/: 'Camping packages can be booked online or by calling the Campground at (403) 249-7372', 'Maximum length of stay is 14 days per each camping season', 'Sites are designated upon check-in', 'We require three days notice to cancel a reservation without penalty'; https://www.calawaypark.com/stay-and-play/campground/campground-pre-booking/

note: Campground at the Calaway Park amusement park on the western edge of Calgary, off the Trans-Canada Hwy 1, a short walk from the park gates, with mountain views. Open treeless rows; sites 1-7 are unserviced and some full-service sites (18-28) are 15-amp only. Season pass holders get 10% off nightly rates outside Stampede. --Claude
